description: Company identity and coverage manifest: name, CIK, exchange, state of incorporation, SIC industry, the fiscal period of the latest data, the SEC filings that record is built from (the annual report and the latest quarterly report, each with its own fiscal year, filing date, accession number and EDGAR link), every published record with its permanent URLs, and the predicted next filing date and form (a prediction from filing history; a filing date is not an earnings date). Pass `record` for an earlier record's manifest.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_company
title: Company profile and coverage manifest
